class: Any quote source that sends its prices once (a scenario snapshot, a fixture frame) behind a SHARED subscription counter loses a contract's price for good as soon as the last counted holder lets go: the counter unsubscribes, the quote is parked, the next sync drops it, and nothing ever re-sends it. A live vendor hides the class because it re-sends a full quote on every re-subscribe.
mechanism: scenario_mode.load subscribes every scenario contract directly on the provider, outside the fan-out's per-instrument holder count; the fan-out built in scenario_mode.overrides therefore counts only socket holders, and when a socket (builder strategy, OI bars, forward strikes) releases, the count reaches zero and FanOut.unsubscribe calls provider.unsubscribe (book.park). feed_bus's drain_subscription_changes then releases the parked quotes for good.

first_seen.where: build/settings (GC-SET step 2 browser proof): backend/ofo_app/scenario_mode.py overrides (FanOut built without a scenario hold); backend/ofo/marketdata/fanout.py unsubscribe; backend/ofo/marketdata/kite_provider.py unsubscribe/drain_subscription_changes
first_seen.evidence: Dev API on ADJ-02: fresh server, strategy 72 Compare costs A-29 92.35 / A-01 173.36 (7 approaches); minutes after a builder socket closed, every approach but A-36 refused USER_INPUT_105 'Leg 3 (SELL NIFTY 23,500.00 CE ...) has no price' and the Paper view read 'prices not live' until a restart. New test tests_app/test_scenario_mode.py::test_a_socket_release_never_drops_a_scenario_quote: without the fix '82 of 82 scenario contracts lost their price'; with the fix the file is 61 passed.

fix: Structural: scenario_mode.overrides holds every scenario contract on the fan-out for the app's life (one no_listener handle, max_queue 1), so no socket release can bring a contract's holder count to zero. Population before: 82 of 82 ADJ-02 contracts lost after one release + drain; after: 0. Replay mode builds a fresh provider per socket and live re-receives on subscribe, so neither is in the class (checked 2026-11-01).

detection.note: The test asserts the scenario's own hold (holder count >= 1 for every contract) AND the symptom (no contract unpriced after a socket hold/release and a drain); the symptom assertion alone fails red without the fix (82 of 82).
